A '''human male''' defected from the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] with a high level [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] security code ingrained into his DNA during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. With the help of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Sarin (rebel agent)|Sarin]], he was transported off of [[Feddasyr]] to unveil this code to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
At some point, a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] defected the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with an important Imperial security code. Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] went to retrieve this code from Jock Tardee's palace on [[Feddasyr]], thinking it was in the vault. The defector would find her trying to break into the vault. Not knowing that he bore the code, she threatened to detonate a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|microthermal detonator]] and kill them both. However, he assured her that he was on her side and explained that the security code she was written to his DNA out of confidentiality. Organa would need to bring him with her in order to get the code back to the Rebel Alliance. Before long, they were spotted and forced to escape from the palace.<ref name="RH2" />

To better mask his identity as they fled into the city, Organa painted the trooper's armor black to resemble a [[TIE pilot|bomber pilot]] and went to a pre-planned drop-off location. There, they rendezvoused with a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] rebel [[Agent/Legends|agent]] named [[Sarin (rebel agent)|Sarin]]. Organa, knowing that she had been spotted, quickly passed a [[communication coin]] to Sarin and sent the defector off with her.<ref name="RH2" />

As Organa let herself be arrested by stormtroopers, Sarin and the defector left for a landing pad. The defector received the communication coin and sent away with Sarin's sister offworld. Upon reaching the planet's atmosphere, he examined the communication coin and learned that his next contact would be [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="RH2" />
